categories.main_business_segments: Hengong Precision Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of precision machined parts and continuous cast iron parts. Its core business includes manufacturing components for air compressors, hydraulic equipment, transmission equipment, and robots, especially humanoid robots. The company also provides one-stop solutions for high-end equipment manufacturing customers, focusing on continuous cast iron technology and precision machining.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced horizontal continuous casting technology for producing high-quality continuous cast iron parts, which improves material uniformity and reduces defects compared to traditional sand casting. It also employs precision machining techniques with micron-level accuracy, and integrates materials science innovations such as rare earth alloy additions for improved mechanical properties. The production process includes continuous casting, heat treatment, and CNC machining, supported by proprietary equipment and process controls.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hengong serves major domestic and international high-end equipment manufacturers, including well-known companies in air compressors, hydraulic systems, industrial robots, and humanoid robots. Key customers include Atlas Copco, Ingersoll Rand, Bosch Rexroth, Danfoss, and Gree. The company’s products are widely used in industries such as mechanical manufacturing, automotive, energy, and robotics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Hebei Province. It also serves international markets, with about 14.4% of its revenue coming from overseas sales. The company actively participates in the Belt and Road Initiative to expand its global presence and deepen cooperation with customers abroad.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hengong operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing core components and precision parts for high-end equipment manufacturers. It controls the production from raw material processing (continuous casting) through precision machining to final component assembly, offering integrated one-stop services that enhance supply chain stability and customer reliance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in continuous casting technology, high-strength cast iron materials, and precision machining processes. It invests heavily in R&D to improve product quality, reduce costs, and develop new applications, especially in emerging fields like humanoid robots and new energy vehicle components. Collaboration with academic institutions like Xi’an University of Technology supports its technology advancement and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Hengong generates revenue primarily through the direct sale of precision machined parts and continuous cast iron components. It employs both direct sales and distributor channels, with a majority of sales conducted via direct contracts with strategic customers. The company also earns investment income from financial assets and equity investments, but product sales remain the core revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic continuous casting iron parts market, with a 63% market share in China and second place globally at 19%. It competes with other precision equipment component manufacturers but differentiates itself through proprietary continuous casting technology and integrated service capabilities. Its strategic partnerships with industry leaders strengthen its competitive moat.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hengong reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.03 billion, representing a 16.9% year-over-year increase. However, net profit attributable to shareholders declined by 45% to about RMB 69.7 million, impacted by increased costs and asset impairment losses. The company’s total assets grew 16% to RMB 2.74 billion, reflecting ongoing investments and capacity expansion. R&D expenses increased by over 30%, underscoring its growth and innovation focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hengong emphasizes its unique continuous casting technology that produces high-strength, lightweight, and wear-resistant cast iron parts with superior uniformity and lower defect rates compared to traditional methods. Its integrated 'casting plus machining' one-stop service reduces customer costs and improves supply reliability. The company’s products offer enhanced mechanical performance, precision, and cost-effectiveness, enabling substitution of forged steel and sand-cast parts in critical applications such as robot reducers and hydraulic valves.
